Build your career at SCOR Bucharest, where top Romanian and international talent shape the future of reinsurance business, finance and technology – keeping SCOR at the forefront of innovation worldwide.
At SCOR, we combine the Art and Science of risk to help build more resilient societies. Technology is a vital resource and partner in every step of our journey. We are seeking innovators to join our dynamic tech team of over 230 professionals across three global hubs. Guided by our corporate values--Collaboration, Courage, Care, Open-Mindedness, and Integrity--our teams develop technology that insures the world. At our brand-new SCOR Bucharest branch, we offer a dynamic environment where career growth is actively supported through internal mobility, globally recognized certifications, and continuous professional development. We value work-life balance, offering flexible work arrangements, and wellbeing initiatives that help you thrive both personally and professionally.Now, lets explore this exciting opportunity so that you can be part of our mission.Gather and Document Requirements: Work with stakeholders to collect, clarify, challenge, and document business and technical needs for financial solutions.Design and Propose Solutions: Develop and recommend system enhancements or new solutions that address business challenges and regulatory requirements.Collaborate with Stakeholders: Coordinate with business teams, IT, testing, and external partners to ensure solutions are aligned and effectively implemented.Support Implementation and Testing: Assist in deploying new systems or changes, including preparing test cases, validating results, and troubleshooting issues.Ensure Compliance and Best Practices: Monitor solutions to ensure ongoing adherence to regulatory standards and internal policies.Degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems.5+ years of experience participating in the software development lifecycle on systems which directly support business initiatives, with architecture and integration components, in an international context.Previous knowledge of financial services industry.Previous experience of reinsurance, Insurance or Investment/AM Banking.A business-driven mindset with a strong appetite to understand functional context.Knowledge of agile and project management methodologies.Excellent interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team and with various stakeholders in IT.Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).EducationBA/MD technical degree in information services management, computer science, applied mathematics or related fields, or equivalent work experience.
